zh.ask: 页面、组件、交互流程
信息架构、流程、体验判断
响应式、验收、用户可见行为验证

en.ask: pages, components, and interaction flows
information architecture, flow design, and UX judgment
responsiveness, acceptance, and user-visible behavior verification

zh: 关键用户路径已有最小可验证闭环
主要页面或视口已有可见验证
未验证体验点已列出
en: A minimal verifiable loop exists for the core user path
The main page or viewport behavior has visible validation
Any unverified UX point is listed

zh.ask: 接口设计、模块边界、服务流程
验证输入输出、错误路径、调用约定
整体结构、模块边界、设计文档

en.ask: API design, module boundaries, and service flow
input/output validation, error paths, and calling contracts
overall structure, module boundaries, and system design docs

zh: 关键接口或流程已有验证证据
边界、风险与未覆盖项已说明
没有把设计描述误报成已交付能力
en: Critical interfaces or flows have verification evidence
Boundaries, risks, and uncovered areas are documented
Design description is not being reported as delivered capability

zh.ask: 主张、文案、内容框架
品牌一致性、视觉叙事
搜索表现、SEO、传播验证

en.ask: messaging, copy, and content framing
brand consistency and visual narrative
search performance, SEO, and distribution validation

zh: 核心主张和预期动作已清晰可见
品牌与转化目标未互相打架
未验证渠道效果的部分已说明
en: The core claim and intended action are clear
Brand and conversion goals are not fighting each other
Any unverified channel-effect assumption is stated

zh.ask: 布局、叙事结构、视觉层级
页面实现、样式、交互落地
可交付性、验证、响应式检查

en.ask: layout, narrative structure, and visual hierarchy
page implementation, styling, and interaction delivery
readiness, verification, and responsive review

zh: 核心叙事和页面骨架已可见可评审
视觉判断与交付判断已区分
未落地的实现或验证空白已说明
en: The core narrative and page skeleton are visible and reviewable
Design judgment and delivery judgment are clearly separated
Any implementation or verification gap is stated explicitly

zh.ask: 目标、范围、优先级、路线
快速原型、第一版实现、方向验证
验收、现实校验、是否真的有进展

en.ask: goal setting, scope, priorities, and roadmap
rapid prototypes, first implementation, and direction validation
acceptance, reality checks, and whether progress is real

zh: 当前输出确实降低了一个关键不确定性
下一步决策所需证据已说明
没有把讨论误报成进展
en: The current output genuinely reduced a key uncertainty
The next evidence needed for a decision is stated
Discussion is not being reported as progress

zh.ask: agent 设计、prompt、tool 调用、上下文策略
MCP、工具接入、外部系统连接
评估、回归、成本稳定性、是否真的有效

en.ask: agent design, prompts, tool calls, and context strategy
MCP, tool integration, and external-system connectivity
evaluation, regression, cost stability, and whether it really works

zh: 关键 agent 回路已有真实样例验证
失败模式、评估方式与回退路径已说明
没有把 prompt 想法误报成稳定能力
en: Critical agent loops have real-example verification
Failure modes, evaluation methods, and rollback paths are documented
Prompt ideas are not being reported as stable capability

zh.ask: 玩法循环、系统设计、任务流程
美术实现、技术美术、性能和资源管线
关卡、节奏、玩家体验验证

en.ask: core loop, systems design, and task flow
visual implementation, technical art, performance, and asset pipeline
level pacing and player experience validation

zh: 核心玩法切片已有可玩验证
性能、反馈或美术实现至少有一项有真实证据
未验证的平台或内容范围已说明
en: The core gameplay slice has playable verification
Performance, feedback, or visual implementation has real evidence
Any unverified platform or content scope is stated

zh.ask: 本地化定位、渠道策略、内容矩阵
小红书、抖音等平台内容与节奏
公众号、私域承接、留存链路

en.ask: localization positioning, channel strategy, and content matrix
Xiaohongshu, Douyin, and platform-specific content rhythm
WeChat, private-domain capture, and retention loops

zh: 核心渠道分工和主张已清楚
至少一个渠道已有样例内容或验证标准
未验证增长假设已说明
en: The core channel split and message are clear
At least one channel has sample content or a validation standard
Any unverified growth assumption is stated

visionOS or device constraints, performance, and comfort

zh: 核心空间任务流已有实际验证
可达性、舒适性或性能至少有一项有证据
未验证的设备或空间判断已说明
en: The core spatial task flow has real validation
Reachability, comfort, or performance has evidence
Any unverified device or spatial judgment is stated
